name: Email/Chat Tone Adapter
headline: Rewrite drafts in a consistent brand voice — concise, warm, no jargon.
description: An instruction-SFT template for support, success, and PR teams who want every outbound message to land in a single recognizable voice. Train a small model to take a raw draft (engineer-speak, terse Slack, or AI-generated boilerplate) and rewrite it to the brand style guide: short opener, plain English, action-first close. Generalizes across email, Slack, in-app notifications, and chat replies once tuned.
suggested_brief: Train a tone adapter that rewrites engineering-speak or terse Slack drafts into the brand voice: warm but concise, plain English (no acronyms or jargon), action-first close. Preserve all facts. Never add information the draft didn't contain.
